description:
make trunk-revert runs agent-write-preflight, which refuses the primary clone, and then make worktree-create. Before #3220, worktree-create run from a managed linked worktree copied the caller's benchbox.worktree.* keys into the new worktree's config.worktree and refused with 'Worktree already carries immutable lifecycle ID', so the 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-20 recoveries were done by hand. #3220 (262eb226675b36d9221f8dc554ffdd03c4913978) clears inherited benchbox.* keys (scripts/worktree_lifecycle.sh:164-171) and adds tests/unit/scripts/test_worktree_create_linked.py. This item closes on evidence; no code change is expected. Stop and reopen as a defect if any check below reproduces the error.

Guardrails: do not run make trunk-revert against a real PR (it pushes a branch and opens a PR); do not push the throwaway branch. Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, after make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. No SKIP or --no-verify, no raw gh pr merge.
